slopium.frame_generation.unavailable: Slopium: frame generation disabled: %s. Normal rendering continues. Apply settings to retry.
slopium.frame_generation_mode.tooltip: Independent of Enable Slopium optimizations. Simple uses camera reprojection, or motion interpolation with parallel output. FSR uses AMD FSR 3; Slopium adds extra phases. Hand and HUD stay separate. Shader packs, Fabulous and standalone FrameGen/PFG are unsupported.
slopium.frame_generation_target.tooltip: Caps real plus generated output. 0 adds no Slopium cap. Minecraft’s limit and VSync still apply; a lower cap reduces the effective multiplier.
slopium.frame_generation_cell.tooltip: One motion vector per grid cell: 8 = an 8×8 pixel tile, 1 = every pixel. Smaller cells preserve finer motion but cost more GPU time and VRAM; 1 has 64× as many cells as 8. Not a guarantee of accurate motion at 1–2 real FPS.
slopium.frame_generation_search.tooltip: Search around the camera motion estimate. Larger values can track faster object motion, but cost more and can match the wrong repeated texture. Range: 4–128 pixels.
slopium.frame_generation_rejection.toolt: Lower values reject more inconsistent motion. With distortion protection, uncertain areas keep a crisp source image instead of warping; movement may jump locally.
slopium.frame_generation_fsr_debug.toolt: Show FSR diagnostic fields instead of normal intermediate frames. Keep off for play. This is frame generation at native resolution, not upscaling.
slopium.enabled.tooltip: Enable lighting, culling and detail optimizations. Frame generation is independent: turn it off in its own section.
slopium.diagnostics.tooltip: Use /slopium status for FPS and skipped-work counters; /slopium reset starts a new measurement. Menus and pauses are excluded.
slopium.indexed_lighting.tooltip: Look up nearby light sources instead of scanning every source. Preserves Sodium Dynamic Lights radius and brightness.
slopium.light_cache.tooltip: Reuse identical lighting queries until light sources update. Useful for repeated block damage draws.
slopium.create_light.tooltip: Allow Create Dynamic Light sources. Turning off also removes its Sable lights; other sources remain.
slopium.sable_light.tooltip: Allow Sable moving-structure lights from Create Dynamic Light. Requires the compatible addon.
slopium.cull_breaking: Skip breaking cracks outside the view
slopium.cull_breaking.tooltip: Skip block breaking cracks outside the camera view. Sable and virtual worlds are excluded.
slopium.hidden_ticks.tooltip: Experimental. Throttle selected Create types confirmed hidden by EntityCulling. Excludes servers, belts, trains and Sable plots. May affect sound and animation. Disabled by default.
slopium.tick_interval: Behind obstacles: one tick out of N
slopium.tick_interval.tooltip: Run one hidden client update out of N: 4 means about 5 updates/s instead of 20. Server rate stays unchanged.
slopium.protected_distance.tooltip: Full-rate radius in blocks for EntityCulling mode only. Wall mode protects 4 blocks; distance mode has its own radius.
slopium.hidden_grace.tooltip: Ticks a mechanism must remain hidden before reducing updates. Visibility or new server data resets the delay. 20 ticks ≈ 1 second.
slopium.disable_be_render.tooltip: Hides world block entity renderers. Static block meshes remain. Ticks and packets continue. Flywheel is controlled separately.
slopium.disable_flywheel_render.tooltip: Skips Flywheel instancing and indirect draws, including moving Create parts. Visual updates and resource maintenance continue. Fallback uses normal renderers.
slopium.disable_particles.tooltip: Skips standard ParticleEngine additions and rendering. Existing particles keep aging. Custom particle systems may remain.
slopium.disable_ambient.tooltip: Stop ambient block/fluid particles and some sounds. Server random ticks and block updates remain unchanged.
slopium.freeze_create_ticks.tooltip: Diagnostic only: freezes initialized Create SmartBlockEntity client ticks, including visible blocks. Animations, indicators and client interactions can malfunction. Packets and server ticks continue. Virtual worlds and Sable-protected blocks are excluded. Disable after measurement; reconnect if necessary.
slopium.item_lod.tooltip: Draw one model per distant item stack instead of multiple copies. Stack size and pickup are unchanged.
slopium.item_lod_distance.tooltip: Blocks from camera. Normal stack models inside, one copy outside; capped by chunk render distance.
slopium.item_range.tooltip: Hide dropped items beyond the radius. Item simulation, stack size and pickup are unchanged.
slopium.item_render_distance.tooltip: Blocks to dropped-item bounds; capped by chunk render distance. 0 hides items away from the camera.
slopium.be_range.tooltip: Cuts distant special models before Sodium preparation. Static blocks and Flywheel remain. Sable-protected positions are excluded. Uses renderer bounds for large models.
slopium.be_render_distance.tooltip: Blocks to model bounds; capped by chunk render distance. May hide machine contents and indicators.
slopium.pause_xaero_benchmark.tooltip: Skip Xaero GPU timing waits. Map uploads continue, but refresh may slow while timing estimates are unavailable.
slopium.disable_shadows.tooltip: Remove vanilla entity shadows on the ground. Shader-pack shadows are unaffected.
slopium.flywheel_distance: Update distant Flywheel animations less often
slopium.flywheel_distance.tooltip: Reduce distant animation updates for models using Flywheel’s distance limiter. Does not affect every model or server ticks.
slopium.flywheel_distance_radius.tooltip: Radius in blocks supplied by the model to Flywheel. Normal animation inside.
slopium.flywheel_interval.tooltip: Update distant Flywheel animations once every N rendered frames.
slopium.item_impostors: Replace distant items with flat sprites
slopium.item_impostors.tooltip: Use a flat material sprite for distant items. Loses shape and depth; named, enchanted and custom-rendered items are excluded.
slopium.item_impostor_distance.tooltip: Blocks from camera. Full models inside, flat sprites outside; capped by chunk render distance.
slopium.create_visuals.tooltip: Update distant presses, mixers and funnels less often. Motion becomes stepped; client ticks and server work continue.
slopium.create_visual_distance.tooltip: Smooth animation within this many blocks, plus a 4-block margin for moving parts.
slopium.create_visual_interval.tooltip: Update distant Create animations once every N rendered frames.
slopium.particle_budget.tooltip: Limit newly added standard particles per client tick. Excess particles are discarded, including informative effects.
slopium.particles_per_tick.tooltip: New particles allowed per tick across the whole standard particle engine. 0 blocks new particles.
slopium.texture_interpolation.tooltip: Stop blending between animated texture frames. Textures still animate, but in steps; also affects inventory icons.
slopium.factory_connections.tooltip: Hides distant connection lines. Panels and server logistics remain intact. Keeps lines near either endpoint and the targeted panel. This reduces visual detail.
slopium.factory_bulbs.tooltip: Hide distant panel indicator bulbs and glow. Panel state and server logic continue updating.
slopium.particle_light_cache.tooltip: Reuse particle light within one block and game tick. Preserves particle count; light changes may lag up to one tick.
slopium.particle_range.tooltip: Hide distant standard particles without stopping their motion or lifetime. Custom particle systems may remain.
slopium.distance_create_ticks.tooltip: Experimental for all Create SmartBlockEntity instances, including visible ones. Runs one tick in N at distance; animations, sounds and client indicators may slow down. Server ticks are untouched. Near camera, in menus, after packets and on Sable uses normal cadence. Replaces hidden-tick mode; full freeze takes priority.
slopium.create_tick_interval: Beyond radius: one tick out of N
slopium.create_tick_interval.tooltip: Run one distant client update out of N. Skipped time is not replayed; effects may slow.
slopium.factory_connection_distance.tool: Blocks to panel centre, plus 2 blocks. Used only for nearby connections; capped by chunk render distance.
slopium.factory_bulb_distance.tooltip: Blocks from camera to panel centre. Indicators remain visible inside; capped by chunk render distance.
slopium.particle_render_distance.tooltip: Blocks to particle bounds; capped by chunk render distance.
slopium.create_tick_distance.tooltip: Full-rate radius to mechanism centre, plus 4 blocks. Nearby or interacting machines keep normal updates.
slopium.occlude_particles.tooltip: Skips particle rendering when 9 bounds samples are blocked by the selected occluders. Simulation continues. Budgeted and cached; unknown means visible. Narrow openings may be misclassified.
slopium.occlude_create_rendering.tooltip: Culls normal Create SmartBlockEntity rendering using renderer bounds and selected occluders. Flywheel is separate. Large/infinite bounds and Sable are excluded.
slopium.occlude_flywheel.tooltip: Hides audited SingleAxisRotatingVisual, ShaftVisual, PressVisual, MixerVisual and FunnelVisual instances through Flywheel API. Restores on visibility or disabling. Not all machines or contraptions are covered. On indirect, opaque model culling uses native Flywheel GPU depth without Slopium CPU model rays. Any-block mode and other backends retain the limited Slopium CPU path. Animation pauses and ticks are checked independently.
slopium.occlude_create_animations.toolti: Skips hidden press, mixer and funnel beginFrame transforms. Geometry is controlled separately by Flywheel occlusion. Workers only read visibility results; no world traversal.
slopium.occlude_create_ticks.tooltip: Runs one tick in N behind walls after grace; uses interval/grace from Visibility page. Normal ticks within 4 blocks of player and during interaction. May slow client effects; server unchanged. Takes priority over distance mode, not full freeze.
slopium.hide_factory_connections.tooltip: No radius: removes all FactoryPanelRenderer connection lines, including nearby. Panels, items and server links remain. Diagnostic detail reduction to isolate line rendering cost.
slopium.factory_items.tooltip: Hide factory-panel item models beyond the radius. Targeted panels and Sable stay visible. Filters and server logistics are unchanged.
slopium.factory_item_distance.tooltip: Blocks from camera to panel centre. Items beyond this radius disappear; capped by chunk render distance.
slopium.particle_occluders.tooltip: Opaque: blocks marked by the game as opaque occluders. Any blocks: also glass, panes, doors, bars, plants and fluids when their shape intersects the ray. Empty parts remain open. Independent per feature; does not enable culling by itself.
slopium.create_render_occluders.tooltip: Opaque: blocks marked by the game as opaque occluders. Any blocks: also glass, panes, doors, bars, plants and fluids when their shape intersects the ray. Empty parts remain open. Independent per feature; does not enable culling by itself.
slopium.flywheel_occluders.tooltip: Opaque: blocks marked by the game as opaque occluders. Any blocks: also glass, panes, doors, bars, plants and fluids when their shape intersects the ray. Empty parts remain open. Independent per feature; does not enable culling by itself.
slopium.animation_occluders.tooltip: Opaque: blocks marked by the game as opaque occluders. Any blocks: also glass, panes, doors, bars, plants and fluids when their shape intersects the ray. Empty parts remain open. Independent per feature; does not enable culling by itself.
slopium.tick_occluders.tooltip: Opaque: blocks marked by the game as opaque occluders. Any blocks: also glass, panes, doors, bars, plants and fluids when their shape intersects the ray. Empty parts remain open. Independent per feature; does not enable culling by itself.
slopium.group.test_warning: Full overrides take priority over normal settings
slopium.particle_visibility.tooltip: Behind opaque blocks: solid walls. Behind any blocks: also glass and other block shapes. Checks the particle centre, so edges may pop. Hide all also stops new standard particles. Custom particle systems may remain; wall checks update with a short delay.
slopium.create_visibility.tooltip: Hide special models behind the selected obstacles, or everywhere. Static block geometry remains; Flywheel is separate. The targeted block stays visible. Centre-based checks can hide partly visible models and update with a short delay.
slopium.flywheel_visibility.tooltip: Obstacle modes cover supported shafts, cogs, gearboxes, fans, presses, mixers and funnels; not every visual. Hide all removes all Flywheel models, including other mods. Static blocks remain. Opaque culling uses native GPU depth on indirect; GPU glass culling is a separate option. Sable is protected.
slopium.animation_visibility.tooltip: Pause supported rotating parts, presses, mixers and funnels behind obstacles or everywhere. Models remain visible; server mechanisms keep running. Requires Flywheel. Other animations remain; obstacle checks may update with a delay.
slopium.create_tick_mode.tooltip: Choose obstacles, distance, EntityCulling or full freeze. Sounds, indicators and client effects may slow or freeze; server simulation continues. Throttling protects nearby/interacting machines. Full freeze can disturb client interactions; turn off to restore.
slopium.factory_connection_mode.tooltip: Show all lines, nearby lines or none. Nearby mode protects either endpoint and targeted panels. Server connections remain intact.
slopium.block_models.tooltip: Show all special block models, only nearby ones or none. Static blocks and Flywheel remain separate. Server mechanisms keep running.
slopium.hint.block_radius: Available only with Special block models → Within radius.
slopium.camera_culling.tooltip: Skip particles, regular Create models and supported Flywheel visuals outside the camera. Combines with wall culling: inside the view AND not hidden. Shares visibility storage. Does not remove world blocks or change server simulation.
slopium.gpu_glass_culling.tooltip: For Flywheel indirect + Behind any blocks: use glass and water depth from Sodium. Open holes stay open; special-renderer obstacles are excluded. Adds a GPU pass and VRAM usage, so may be slower on a busy GPU. Shaders/Fabulous use CPU fallback. Ticks and animation checks stay on CPU.
slopium.frame_generation_mark.tooltip: Show a pink stripe on sequential generated frames. Useful for checking that generation is active; not available with parallel output.
slopium.frame_generation_multiplier.tool: Up to 1 new frame at ×2 or 31 at ×32. Real frames have priority; frames that do not fit the time budget are skipped. GPU speed, output limits and VSync determine the achieved rate.
slopium.group.frame_hybrid: Motion quality: parallel / extra FSR frames
slopium.frame_generation_grid.tooltip: Sequential Simple only. 1 gives finer geometry edges; 4 balances quality and GPU cost; 16 is cheaper. Reprojects depth to the current camera; cannot reconstruct surfaces absent from the source frame.
slopium.frame_generation_counter.tooltip: Recent rates, updated about once per second, shared with F3. Real: world frames rendered by Minecraft. Output: successful window presentations, including repeated images; not monitor refresh rate. Generated counts only presented synthetic frames. HUD refreshes with real frames.
slopium.frame_generation.conflict: Disabled: remove standalone FrameGen/PFG from mods and restart Minecraft.
slopium.frame_generation_input.tooltip: With amortization: desired total FPS, 0 = 60. Without it: source FPS target; parallel mode caps real FPS at this value, while 0 leaves them uncapped. Sequential mode uses 0 to estimate its baseline. Generation cannot guarantee the target.
slopium.frame_generation_fast.tooltip: Skip repeated world preparation on the main render thread. Hand, HUD, input and ticks remain live. Disable if another mod renders incorrectly. Not used with parallel generation.
slopium.frame_generation_parallel.toolti: Simple or FSR generates on a separate thread while Minecraft is busy. Only the world is interpolated; hand and HUD are overlaid unchanged at the source update rate. Adds about one source frame of latency. Needs extra GPU time and VRAM. Menus, focus loss and post-effects pause it.
slopium.frame_generation_amortize.toolti: Fill the gap to Target FPS automatically. 30 → 60 needs about ×2; 1 → 60 about ×60. Stops synthesis above the target and ignores the manual multiplier. This does not cap real FPS. Requires GPU headroom; output limits and VSync still apply.
slopium.number.hint: Right-click or Shift + left-click to enter an exact number (Sodium and Reese).
slopium.frame_generation_refinement.tool: 0: whole-pixel search. 1–4: refine to 1/2, 1/4, 1/8 or 1/16 pixel. Higher values improve small motion at extra GPU cost; they cannot recover unseen details.
slopium.frame_generation_protect.tooltip: Preserve motion boundaries and prefer per-pixel depth for camera motion. Reject uncertain warps and use a crisp source patch. Reduces smearing, but may cause local jumps. Extra GPU work; does not fix artifacts inside native FSR itself.
